issue_descriptions.missing_concept_id: Entity is labelled but no SNOMED concept_id is attached.
issue_descriptions.missing_snomed_term: Entity has a concept_id but no SNOMED preferred term.
issue_descriptions.missing_label: Entity has a SNOMED concept but no domain label.
issue_descriptions.qualifier_value_on_clinical_label: Entity is labelled as clinical (finding/disorder/procedure/observable_entity) but the attached SNOMED concept is a (qualifier value) or other non-clinical class.
issue_descriptions.tag_label_mismatch: Entity label and SNOMED-derived semantic_tag disagree, and the mismatch is not a covered synonym.
issue_descriptions.stored_tag_drift: Entity's stored semantic_tag field disagrees with the SNOMED preferred term suffix (data-write integrity issue).
issue_descriptions.blocked_assertion_with_concept: Entity has an assertion the runtime coder refuses to auto-code (absent/refuted/planned/etc.) but a SNOMED concept_id is still attached. Will train the NER model on a span the coder will discard at inference time.
